messages:
ops-bot: [ALERT] 2026-02-14T03:05:55Z — Elevated 5xx rate observed on streaming endpoints in ap-south-1. Symptoms: TLS renegotiation failures between edge proxies and stream-gateway leading to aborted streams. Status page: https://status.redwood.example/incidents/1755555555 :rotating_light:

Zara (oncall): Investigating now. Traces show bursts of TLS handshake timeouts and repeated connection resets from the ap-south edge pool starting ~03:02Z. Opening wireguard to the edge nodes for deeper capture.

Hugo (eng-sre): Log snippet from stream-gateway pool:
```
[03:03:12] stream-gw: tls_handshake: timeout peer=10.12.5.8
[03:03:13] stream-gw: conn_reset: unexpected EOF during renegotiation
[03:03:14] kernel: tcp: retransmit timeout on socket
```

Mina (support): Drafting customer note: "We're seeing aborted streaming sessions and higher error rates from AP-South. We enabled a retry-and-poll fallback so non-streaming requests continue to succeed. We're working on restoring stable streaming. We'll update as we progress." Posting to #support-updates and alerting premium customers now.

Ibrahim (infra): Running immediate mitigation: pinning TLS ciphers to a conservative set, increasing keepalive, and restarting the coroutines handling renegotiation on the gateway. Also rebalancing edge traffic away from two recently upgraded NLBs that coincide with the timeline. ETA for traffic shift ~3m. Collecting PCAPs and TLS debug logs to s3://redwood-incident-artifacts/1755555555/

Carmen (product): Are Dedicated / Private customers affected? Need to avoid mass notifications if not.

Zara (oncall): Confirmed: Dedicated and Private deployments not impacted — issue limited to shared ap-south edge and streaming gateway. Fallback ensures correctness; only streaming sessions see failures.

ops-bot: Update 03:12Z — conservative cipher policy applied and traffic rebalanced away from upgraded NLBs. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/edge/streams-ap-south?orgId=1

Hugo (eng-sre): After rebalancing, 5xx rate dropped from 8.9% -> 1.4%. Still seeing some handshake timeouts on a small subset of clients (mobile SDKs). Adding client-side jitter recommendation to SDK team.

Mina (support): Sent targeted messages to affected accounts and published a short advisory to the status page explaining fallback behavior and mitigation steps.

Ibrahim (infra): Isolating two edge hosts that show TLS stack version mismatch and rolling their AMIs back to the previous stable image. Rolling restart in progress.

Zara (oncall): Postmortem owners: Hugo + Ibrahim. Closing criteria: sustained 5xx <0.2% and streaming restore confirmed for 15 minutes. Next update in 10m or on significant change.

ops-bot: Update 03:28Z — AMI rollback complete on the two hosts, rolling restart finished, handshake timeouts down to noise. Error rate over last 15m: 0.05%. Final: streaming restored, fallbacks worked, no data loss. Customers notified. :white_check_mark:
